snippet.title: Dark Realm Free Update and Crowns of History DLC Out Now! | The King is Watching
snippet.description:
The first DLC for The King Is Watching is OUT NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3951490/Crowns_of_History/

The King Is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder that has recently been receiving Overwhelmingly Positive reviews on Steam. You are the King, and your folks only work when you watch them. Can you manage producing resources and training your armies to lead your Kingdom to glory? 

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/yCGZZdNgaD
Twitter (X): https://x.com/TKIWGame
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/TheKingIsWatching/
